decisions: Order: language/reading, content filters, extensions/repositories, privacy/Vault, sync/backup, storage/reset, application information. Keep every existing action and its callback/enabled condition.

Place the existing extensions shortcut inside the repository section. Explain that first install adds no repositories or extensions and describe manual repository selection followed by extension installation.

Use existing DeepOledBlack, CardSurface, HairlineBorder and TextMuted tokens. Standardize 24dp section gaps, 12dp header spacing, 20dp action icons, 56dp minimum action rows and 72dp minimum switch rows; retain expanding text layouts.
Keep repository loading indicators in the switch-sized trailing slot. Put the hidden badge below the title so long localized titles retain room.
Use the existing update-dialog visual convention for all settings dialogs: 24dp corners, CardSurface, zero tonal elevation and muted body copy. Inline repository errors remain inline.

SettingsCopy.kt now owns mirrored TR/EN filter and repository display copy. Existing SettingsCopy fields are injected from app resources, so only corresponding settings resource entries were updated in both locales; no MainActivity edit was needed.
Repository display descriptions avoid unverified source counts; persisted repository IDs, URLs, tag keys and preference semantics are unchanged. No shared component change was necessary.
